title: KeywordList - Tooling API
description: Represents a list of keywords used in Experience Cloud site moderation. Available in Tooling API version 36.0 and later.

Description.description: A description of the keyword list.

DeveloperName.description: The developer’s internal name for the keyword list used in the API.

FullName.description: The full name of the associated metadata object in Metadata API. Query this field only if the query result contains no more than one record. Otherwise, an error is returned. If more than one record exists, use multiple queries to retrieve the records. This limit protects performance.

Language.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort.
Language.description: The language of the keyword list. Valid values are: Chinese (Simplified): zh_CN Chinese (Traditional): zh_TW Danish: da Dutch: nl_NL English: en_US Finnish: fi French: fr German: de Italian: it Japanese: ja Korean: ko Norwegian: no Portuguese (Brazil): pt_BR Russian: ru Spanish: es Spanish (Mexico): es_MX Spanish (Mexico) defaults to Spanish for customer-defined translations. Swedish: sv Thai: th The Salesforce user interface is fully translated to Thai, but Help is in English.

Metadata.description: KeywordList metadata. Query this field only if the query result contains no more than one record. Otherwise, an error is returned. If more than one record exists, use multiple queries to retrieve the records. This limit protects performance.

wsdl_segment:
```xml
<xsd:complexType name="KeywordList">
  <xsd:complexContent>
    <xsd:extension base="mns:Metadata">
      <xsd:sequence>
        <xsd:element name="description" minOccurs="0" type="xsd:string"/>
        <xsd:element name="keywords" minOccurs="0" maxOccurs="unbounded" type="mns:Keyword"/>
        <xsd:element name="masterLabel" type="xsd:string"/>
      </xsd:sequence>
    </xsd:extension>
  </xsd:complexContent>
</xsd:complexType>
```
